ownership.bindinfo_store: Durable pre-Engine class records. Hosts hold TSharedRef<const FAngelscriptTypeBindInfoStore>.
ownership.metadata_image: TUniquePtr intermediate. No std::shared_ptr for Image, Image dependencies, publication lifetime or TypeInfo.
ownership.typeinfo: Unique per receiving Engine. A and B share publication IDs, never TypeInfo pointers.
ownership.registry: asCTypeIdRegistry issues process IDs only; it does not own TypeInfo or Image.
ownership.admission: TypeInfo.GetEngine() and Function.GetEngine() are Engine admission. Image BoundEngine is not authority.
